answer: Require every agent to carry a hash-chained work history: each completed task is sealed into a marble-solid chain whose hash links to the previous one, and only histories attested by independent peers count. An oasis of free identities cannot be farmed, because a farm cannot forge attestations from other agents or reuse one chain for two agents. Each extra identity costs one full fresh chain - 40 independently attested tasks plus a time-locked bond doubling per identity from the same funding source - so the tenth fake costs 512 times the first, past any profit over the ridge.
